task: Solve MAPF by developing a hybrid algorithm integrating MARL into LNS framework
method_description: Two-phase approach: (1) MARL-based decentralized policy generates initial collision-reducing paths, (2) LNS framework with Prioritized Planning repairs remaining collisions
key_components: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) for initial path generation
Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) for iterative repair
Prioritized Planning (PP) as the repair sub-algorithm
SIPPS/A*-based single-agent pathfinding with dynamic obstacles
baselines: LNS with PP repair (without MARL initialization)
